खली १

KHALĪ I . A synonym of Mahāviṣṇu. (M.B. Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 17, Stanza 43).

खली २

KHALĪ II . An asura dynasty. Mention is made in mahābhārata, anuśāsana parva, Chapter 155, Stanza 22, that vasiṣṭha once destroyed an asura dynasty called khalī, with his effulgence.

खलु

KHALU . A river of ancient india. (M.B. bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 28).
